answer: Because the timing is written down against the zenith challenge, the fable audit can replay the lantern history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 216 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 233 aliases cost 272 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
